newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filinvest group open to sell stake in Bonifacio.
newsitem.headline: Filinvest group open to sell stake in Bonifacio.

text.p: Filinvest Development Corp and its subsidiary Filinvest Land Inc are open to selling their holdings in the Bonifacio Land Corp (BLC), FLI executive vice-president Joseph Yap said on Friday.

BLC is made up of 17 private firms which hold 55 percent of Fort Bonifacio Development Corp (FBDC), developer of a 214-hectare lot on the edge of Manila's Makati business district. The land is being transformed into the country's next financial hub.
"Just in anything, if the price is right, we might be interested (to sell)," Yap told reporters after the stockholders' meeting of Filinvest Land.
FDC and FLI had rejected earlier offers from other real estate firms that wanted to buy their stake in Bonifacio.
"In the past, some people have approached us about it. And our answer had always been: We're not interested in selling," Yap said. He declined to give further explanation.
FDC owns 11.3 percent of BLC and FLI, five percent. They are the second biggest group after Metro Pacific Corp.
The Filinvest group is currently developing its own 244 hectare central business district in Alabang, just south of Manila.
